node.title: Re^3: Easing cross-platform scripting
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Thanks for the example - just to pick a couple nits:

  • eval "..."; die $@ if $@; [id://1153468|has issues], eval "...; 1" or die $@; is better
  • [doc://perlobj#Indirect-Object-Syntax] is discouraged, Win32::SerialPort->new($port, 1) is better
  • Instead of [doc://eval]ing a [doc://use], in this case a [doc://require] is enough.
  • You don't need the duplicate $IS_WINDOWS, it's easier to do my $IS_WINDOWS; BEGIN { $IS_WINDOWS = ...
